title: drea-describe/1
description: Machine readable description of a drea CLI app, as printed by the describe builtin command

conventions.description: Fixed explanatory strings plus the closed value sets used by this schema

env-prefix.description: Present only when the app reads options from environment variables

root.description: The positional arguments the app accepts with no command given; absent when the app only takes commands

params-names.description: Display names of the positional params

param-choices.description: Closed set of legal values of the positional param (requires exactly one param)

name.description: Pass on the command line as --name

param-name.description: Display name of the option's value(s); absent for flags

nb-params.description: Fixed number of values the option takes per use

choices.description: Closed set of legal values; absent means unrestricted

default.description: Always an array of values, except for sensitive options where it is the string [redacted]

env.description: Exact environment variable name; present only when an env prefix is set and the option's scope permits config sources

deprecated.description: Present only when the option is deprecated

name.description: The word typed on the command line; nested commands follow their parents: app cmd subcmd

params-names.description: Display names of the positional params

param-choices.description: Closed set of legal values of the positional param; present only on commands that declare it (requires exactly one param)

local-options.description: Option names (see top-level options) valid only for this command

global-options.description: Option names valid for this command and its subcommands

groups.description: Groups gating this command; present only when the command is group-gated

examples.description: Worked invocations; present only when the command declares them

deprecated.description: Present only when the command is deprecated
